title: Pokemon TCG Telepathic Psychic Energy Perfect Order 088/088 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Telepathic Psychic Energy card from the Perfect Order set in the Pokémon TCG is a rare, English-language collectible card made of card stock. Manufactured by The Pokémon Company, this special energy card features a holo finish and is numbered 088/088. With a standard size and designed for ages 6 and up, this card is a valuable addition to any Pokémon card collection, particularly for fans of the Pokémon League event.
